card.name: Stray bracket and quote marks
card.fires_on: Repeated or doubled punctuation such as << , [[, >>, '' or ?? that sits in the text where a normal sentence or link would continue. It marks markup-like debris, not a real word.

modes.label: Doubled brackets
modes.description: Opening or closing angle or square brackets, often doubled, left in the text as navigation or link debris.

modes.label: Doubled quotes or question marks
modes.description: A second quote mark or question mark right after sentence-ending punctuation.
